fetch_rcv1_dataset: fetch the RCV1 multilabel classification dataset with train, test, or all subsets and shuffle support
fetch_rcv1_subset: fetch the RCV1 training or test subset with specified data home directory and random state
fetch_rcv1_return_xy: fetch the RCV1 dataset returning X and y arrays directly instead of a Bunch object
fetch_rcv1_shuffle: fetch the RCV1 dataset with shuffled samples using a reproducible random state
fetch_rcv1_retry: fetch the RCV1 dataset with configurable retry count and delay for HTTP error handling
